crossRefs.note: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.
I saw the earth, and, behold, it was waste and void, and the heavens, and they had no light.
He stood, and shook the earth. He looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains were crumbled. The…
I saw a great white throne, and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away. There was found…
(The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.)
But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.
God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.

people.name: Lebanon

translations.web: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.
translations.bsb: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.
translations.kjv: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
translations.asv: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild-ox.
